create table t1 (c1 int, c2 int, c3 int);    
  create table t2 (id int);

begin    
  for i in 1..100 LOOP    
  insert into t1 values (i,i,i);    
  end loop;    
  end;    
  /

begin    
  for i in 1..10 LOOP    
  insert into t2 values (i);    
  end loop;    
  end;    
  /

  
  commit;
